title: Operation on a resource after expiration or release in the AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could…
description: A vulnerability in the AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware allows an attacker with administrative privileges to perform operations on a resource after it has expired or been released. This flaw could enable the attacker to swap out a guest device without the guest's knowledge, potentially compromising confidentiality and integrity.
